universities.notes: UKT group (1-11 in 2025/2026 and 2026/2027) is assigned per student based on the paying capacity of whoever finances the student; a non-subsidised middle/upper-income family should plan for the programme's top group (e.g. Pendidikan Dokter UKT 11 = Rp20.000.000/semester; Ilmu Komputer UKT 9 = Rp14.600.000). SNBP/SNBT pay UKT only; Jalur Mandiri pays the same UKT table plus a one-time IPI whose tier follows the UKT group (IPI 1 for UKT 1-2 = Rp0 up to IPI 4 for UKT 9-11, e.g. Rp120.000.000 for Pendidikan Dokter). KKI (international class) pays a flat UKT plus IPI. Faculty left null: the decrees/articles list programmes only. Overseas-status registration: Rp1.100.000/semester (reguler/mandiri), Rp2.475.000/semester (KKI). Trend: for the five sampled S1 programmes, 2025/2026 UKT (Kompas, citing SK 681/2025) and 2025/2026 IPI (SK 688/2025) equal the 2026/2027 values; 2024/2025 (Kontan) used 5 groups whose top amounts were close to today's top groups (e.g. Manajemen Rp14.650.000 in 2024 vs Rp14.600.000 in 2025/2026 and 2026/2027), so the restructuring mainly added lower/middle groups rather than raising the ceiling.

universities.notes: S1 UKT uses groups I-VIII (most programmes I-VII; Kedokteran I-VI), assigned by the economic capacity of parents/guardians.
